invites_shape.name: invites_shape
invites_shape.value:
("invites"."kind" = 'join' and "invites"."role" is not null and "invites"."role" in ('owner', 'parent', 'carer')
            and "invites"."display_name" is not null and "invites"."person_id" is null)
       or ("invites"."kind" = 'recovery' and "invites"."person_id" is not null and "invites"."role" is null)

overrides_target.name: overrides_target
overrides_target.value: ("overrides"."target_kind" = 'everything' and "overrides"."target_id" is null) or ("overrides"."target_kind" in ('service', 'group') and "overrides"."target_id" is not null)

services_source.name: services_source
services_source.value: ("services"."source" = 'adguard' and "services"."adguard_id" is not null) or ("services"."source" = 'custom' and "services"."adguard_id" is null)
